settings.title: Pieces that make a house feel like home
settings.text: Furniture, lighting and kitchen essentials from trusted brands — delivered free across the UK.

settings.title: Chosen with care
settings.text: Fernatto is a small UK home store. We stock genuine products from established brands, chosen for how well they're made and how long they'll last — and we deliver them free to your door.

settings.question: How much is delivery and how long does it take?
settings.answer: Delivery to UK mainland addresses is free. We dispatch within 1–2 business days and delivery takes 2–4 business days, so your order arrives in 3–6 business days in total.

settings.question: Can I return something?
settings.answer: Yes. You can return any item within 14 days of delivery. Returns are free — a prepaid return label is included in your parcel — and there is no restocking fee.

settings.question: When will I get my refund?
settings.answer: We refund to your original payment method within 5 business days of receiving your return.

settings.question: Can I exchange an item?
settings.answer: Yes, exchanges are accepted within the same 14-day window. Contact us and we'll arrange it.

settings.question: Are the products genuine?
settings.answer: Yes. Every product is brand new and genuine, sourced from the manufacturer or its authorised distribution.
